reason: I already pay for amoCRM and it works, even if it is slow. $89 a month is more than a tenth of what I earn in a year, so I cannot justify it for a tool nobody I know uses.
objection: Who else uses it? I cannot find any company I know, and only 1 to 5 companies pay for it. At $89 I would be the guinea pig.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $20 to $25 a month, plus a shop owner I know who uses it and will tell me it works.
